reason: A read-only web UI dashboard that visualizes DeepSeek Harness session usage, context composition, token metrics, timing, cache statistics, and balance information.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中提供可拖动的只读会话用量、上下文、令牌、缓存、耗时和余额可视化面板。
summaries.en: Adds a draggable read-only dashboard to the DeepSeek Harness web UI for visualizing session usage, context, token, cache, timing, and balance metrics.

capabilities: Displays read-only session, context-window, token, timing, cache, and model metrics
Provides a draggable floating dashboard panel in the web UI
Fetches DeepSeek total_balance through a configured same-origin route and external API integration
